description: National Bank of Pakistan, which calls itself "The Nation's Bank", is a commercial bank operating a branch network across Pakistan. It provides corporate banking, Shariah-compliant Islamic banking through dedicated Islamic Banking branches, home remittance services for overseas Pakistanis, agriculture financing under its Kisan Dost programme, and digital banking through the NBP Digital app.
headOffice: NBP Building, I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: https://www.nbp.com.pk/contact/index.aspx (head office, telephone), https://www.nbp.com.pk/Islamic/index.aspx, https://www.nbp.com.pk/CorporateBanking/index.aspx, https://www.nbp.com.pk/hrem/index.aspx, https://www.nbp.com.pk/KisanDost/index.aspx, https://www.nbp.com.pk/digital/index.aspx and the bank's own press release https://nbp.com.pk/PRESS-RELEASE/NBP_warmly_welcomes_Mr_Imran_Sarwar.pdf (9 September 2026) (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Corporate banking
products.summary: Banking for corporate clients, delivered through the bank's corporate branches.

products.name: Islamic banking — NBP Aitemaad
products.summary: Shariah-compliant deposit schemes and financing facilities available through dedicated Islamic Banking branches, free of Riba.

products.name: Home remittance
products.summary: Receipt of home remittances for overseas Pakistanis through more than 1,500 branches and the bank's remittance partners worldwide.

products.name: Kisan Dost
products.summary: The bank's agriculture farming programme: financing at competitive mark-up, technical guidance to farmers at their doorstep, and facilities against pass book, property, gold ornaments or paper security.

products.name: NBP Digital
products.summary: The bank's mobile banking application, serving customers of both conventional and Aitemaad Islamic banking.
